items.exampleEn: Advertising on TV is very expensive.
items.exampleZh: 在電視上打廣告非常貴。

items.exampleEn: This portrait of my mother is my favorite picture.
items.exampleZh: 這幅我媽媽的畫像是我最喜歡的畫。

items.exampleEn: My aunt writes fiction for young readers.
items.exampleZh: 我阿姨為年輕讀者寫小說。

items.exampleEn: Each episode is about thirty minutes long.
Each country has its own customs.
items.exampleZh: 每個國家都有自己的習俗。

items.exampleEn: My cousin's paintings are in a gallery in Taipei.
items.exampleZh: 我表親的畫作在台北的一間畫廊展出。

items.exampleEn: I saw an advertisement for this hotel in a magazine.
items.exampleZh: 我在雜誌上看到這家飯店的廣告。

items.sentenceEn: I watched three episodes of the show last night.
items.sentenceZh: 我昨晚看了這部影集的三集。

items.audioEn: The gallery is closed on Mondays, so let's go on Tuesday.
items.audioZh: 畫廊星期一休館，我們星期二去吧。
items.questionZh: 他們打算哪一天去畫廊？

items.sentenceEn: My brother loves science fiction movies.
items.sentenceZh: 我的兄弟很愛科幻電影。

items.sentenceEn: There are too many advertisements on TV.

items.stemEn: The painter is painting a ____ of the queen.
items.stemZh: 畫家正在畫女王的肖像。

items.stemEn: My sister works in ____. She makes posters for new products.
items.stemZh: 我的姊妹在廣告業工作，她替新產品做海報。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, I visited a small art gallery with my aunt, who is a painter. There were many portraits of famous people. One portrait looked like a star from a classic movie. In another room, there was an old advertisement for soap from sixty years ago. My aunt told me about the customs of that time: "People always wore hats when they went out!"
items.passageZh: 上週六，我和當畫家的阿姨去了一間小畫廊。那裡有很多名人的肖像，其中一幅看起來很像經典老電影裡的明星。另一個房間裡有一張六十年前的肥皂舊廣告。阿姨跟我說了那個年代的習俗：「那時候大家出門都會戴帽子！」

rubricZh: 可寫例如 a classic movie、a classic film

referenceEn: The fiction books are on the second floor of the library.
Fiction is on the second floor of the library.
rubricZh: 用 fiction 表示「小說」（例如 fiction、fiction books 等）
「二樓」可寫，例如 the second floor 等
